messages.text: At 29.2¢ your power cost matters more than most, so let's size it right. Heads up: the H15 Dual isn't buyable yet — the drop date hasn't been announced. Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?
first
Ran the power-cost calculator · 29.2¢/kWh
Read the magic miner 40t page

Honest math at 29.2¢: the Magic Miner 40T ($799, 40 TH/s) draws 650 W — about $137 a month in power, or $95 in its 30 TH Eco mode. That's real money, so most first buyers at your rate start smaller.

What's your budget, and is it going on a desk or in a garage?
i'll keep thta in mind. Thank you

GekkoScience KBOX

Want me to check the current ship date on it?
